stage1_evidence_shown.label: METHOD
stage1_evidence_shown.context: This study represents a subset of a complete data set, considering only those children aged admitted to the Pediatric Surgery and Pediatric Nephrology Clinics during the period January 2011 to July 2012.

stage2_added_evidence.label: RESULT
stage2_added_evidence.context: In this study, we have determined that the QT interval changes significantly depending on the use of oxybutynin. The QT changes increased cardiac arrhythmia in children.
